items.title: Kernelised covariance matrices, dimension reduction and imbalanced spectral clustering
items.title_zh: 核化协方差矩阵、降维与不平衡谱聚类
items.summary_zh: 高斯混合模型（缩写GMM）是聚类数据的经典生成模型，基于PCA降维的谱聚类一直是有效的框架。在这项工作中，我们研究核化协方差矩阵作为降维和谱聚类的替代机制，重点关注选择具有合适分离约束的数据点对的截断核。这些矩阵的结构受到排斥粒子系统统计力学考虑的启发。我们的方法特别适用于不平衡聚类设置，其中最大和最小聚类的大小随问题规模呈发散比例，而现有的基于PCA的方法效果有限。我们展示了这些修改后的协方差矩阵的高效降维和聚类性能，并由定量边界证实。特别是，在不平衡聚类机制中，它们在广泛的参数范围内实现了优于PCA的降维保证。对于谱聚类，我们的方法在不平衡设置中表现出优于PCA的改进，特别是在更大的簇内分离范围内保证准确聚类。我们的理论保证反映在一系列模拟实验中，这些实验展示了在不平衡聚类问题上的这些改进。我们基于核拉普拉斯算子的分析方法为聚类问题提供了工具箱以及相关的概念性要素。我们相信我们的工作将

extra.description: The Gaussian Mixture Model (abbrv. GMM) is a classic generative model for clustered data, for which spectral clustering based on dimension reduction via PCA has been an effective framework. In this work, we investigate kernelised covariance matrices as an alternative mechanism for dimension reduction and spectral clustering, focusing on truncation kernels that select pairs of data points with suitable separation constraints. The structure of these matrices is motivated by considerations from statistical mechanics of repulsive particle systems. Our approach is particularly relevant for the setting of imbalanced clusters, where the sizes of the largest and smallest clusters have a diverging ratio with the problem size, and existing PCA-based methods turn out to be of limited effectiveness. We demonstrate efficient dimension reduction and clustering performance of these modified covariance matrices, substantiated by quantitative bounds. In particular, they achieve superior dimension reduction guarantees compared to PCA for a wide range of parameters in the regime of imbalanced clusters. For spectral clustering, our approach exhibits improvements over PCA in the imbalanced setting, in particular guaranteeing accurate clustering in a much larger regime of intra-cluster separations. Our theoretical guarantees reflected in a range of simulation experiments that exhibit these improvements for unbalanced clustering problems. Our analytical approach, based on kernel Laplacians, provide a toolbox as well as a relevant conceptual ingredient for clustering problems at large. We believe that our work will motivate the application of such kernelised covariance matrices for related classes of statistical problems, as well as spur new investigations in the theory of random matrices.

items.title: Learning Population Dynamics with Variational Doob-Wasserstein Flow
items.title_zh: 用变分Doob-Wasserstein流学习种群动力学
items.summary_zh: 本文介绍了一种新颖的无模拟框架，用于在黎曼Wasserstein-Fisher-Rao（WFR）流形上学习不平衡种群动力学，称为变分Doob-Wasserstein流（VDWF），建立在非平衡平均场薛定谔桥（MFSB）理论之上。首先，通过独立学习配备数据依赖度量的几何模型，我们的模型捕捉种群动力学的内在几何结构。此外，利用Doob的h变换，所提出的方法结合边界信息以改善基于流的轨迹推断。对于不平衡传输，采用增长模型学习动力学，同时在WFR空间中构建中间质量样本而无需模拟。此外，我们使用一致Log-Sobolev不等式（LSI）分析了所提出框架的收敛速率。最后，我们在多个真实世界数据集上验证了所提出的方法，展示了与最先进方法相比在学习平衡和不平衡种群动力学方面的竞争性能。

extra.description: This paper introduces a novel simulation-free framework for learning unbalanced population dynamics on the Riemannian Wasserstein-Fisher-Rao (WFR) manifold, termed Variational Doob-Wasserstein Flow (VDWF), built upon the theory of the unbalanced mean-field Schrödinger bridge (MFSB). First, by independently learning a geometry model equipped with a data-dependent metric, our model captures the intrinsic geometric structure of population dynamics. Furthermore, leveraging Doob's h-transform, the proposed method incorporates boundary information to improve flow-based trajectory inference. For unbalanced transport, a growth model is employed to learn the dynamics while constructing intermediate mass samples in the WFR space without simulation. Additionally, we analyze the convergence rate of the proposed framework using a uniform Log-Sobolev inequality (LSI). Finally, we validate the proposed approach on multiple real-world datasets, demonstrating competitive performance in learning both balanced and unbalanced population dynamics compared with state-of-the-art methods.

items.title: An autoencoder outperforms two transformers on prediction of gene expression from chromatin accessibility
items.title_zh: 自编码器在从染色质可及性预测基因表达上优于两个 transformer
items.summary_zh: 从染色质可及性预测 RNA 丰度的模型很少在相同特征、目标和指标下比较。我们在来自 19 项人类研究的 126,604 个配对单核图谱上构建了一个基准，共享 50,000 个峰和 3,185 个基因的词表、十个 5x2 交叉验证折和一个评分目标，并在 70 次训练运行中比较了七个已实现流程和两个参考预测器；每个流程保留自己的输入归一化和原生训练目标。基于双变分自编码器的 scButterfly-B 流程在所有六十个配对折比较中，在每基因和细胞内 Spearman 相关上优于所有 transformer 流程，包括自回归 Perceiver 模型（Omic Translator）和无支持重构的 Cisformer，训练时间短 3.8 倍。Transformer 流程在细胞内轮廓形状上差距为 0.02-0.04，但在每基因相关上落后 0.10-0.24。在两个留出细胞类型上每基因相关较低；对照

extra.description: Models that predict RNA abundance from chromatin accessibility are rarely compared under the same features, targets and metrics. We built one benchmark on 126,604 paired single-nucleus profiles from 19 human studies with a shared vocabulary of 50,000 peaks and 3,185 genes, ten 5x2 cross-validation folds and one scoring target, and compared seven implemented pipelines and two reference predictors across 70 trained runs; each pipeline keeps its own input normalisation and native training target. The scButterfly-B pipeline, built on dual variational autoencoders, outperformed every transformer pipeline, including an autoregressive Perceiver model (Omic Translator) and a support-free reformulation of Cisformer, on per-gene and within-cell Spearman correlation in all sixty paired fold comparisons, with 3.8 times shorter training. Transformer pipelines come within 0.02-0.04 on within-cell profile shape but lag by 0.10-0.24 on per-gene correlation. On two withheld cell types per-gene correlation is low; controls show the podocyte values are typical of within-type correlation for seen cell types of the same size, whereas Paneth values match a cell-agnostic shuffle for every Omic Translator arm. Within the transformer family, prespecified ablations show the Perceiver encoder was worth +0.0439 in within-donor per-gene correlation over full self-attention, a chromosome-aware genomic attention prior reduced it by 0.0096 (exact donor-level sign-flip test, Holm-adjusted p = 1.2e-4), and decoder output order had no detectable effect. A training-mean profile reaches 0.314 within-cell correlation with no input and a constant at the true expressed-gene positions reaches 0.996 per-gene correlation, so oracle-support protocols are reported only as diagnostics. Code, results and an audited release are provided.

items.title: Spatially Informed and Direction Sensitive Representation Learning for Spatial Transcriptomics
items.title_zh: 面向空间转录组学的空间信息感知和方向敏感表示学习
items.summary_zh: 细胞状态由内在基因表达程序和细胞所在的空间微环境共同塑造。空间转录组学使这一背景变得可测量，但有效的表示学习需要同时捕获空间信息分子信号和细胞间组织。现有方法只能部分解决这些挑战：传统基因选择可能忽略空间结构化信号，而编码细胞-细胞关系的方法通常要么将细胞的微环境简化为仅邻近性，丢弃方向，要么依赖与任意组织框架绑定的绝对坐标。因此，具有相似邻居距离但不同空间组织的细胞可能获得过于相似的表示，尽管它们经历着塑造其细胞状态的不同生物背景。我们介绍Tessera，一个空间表示学习框架，同时解决分子选择和细胞背景问题。Tessera将空间信息基因选择与几何归纳偏置相结合，将每个细胞置于其局部组织环境中。通过建模相对细胞-细胞关系，Tessera具有平移不变性同时保留方向，允许邻近细胞根据其空间背景和细胞状态做出不同贡献。在留出组织和技术上，Tessera在表示质量上优于现有空间基础模型，并零样本泛

extra.description: Cellular states are shaped by both intrinsic gene expression programs and the spatial microenvironment in which cells reside. Spatial transcriptomics makes this context measurable, but effective representation learning requires capturing both spatially informative molecular signals and intercellular organization. Existing approaches address these challenges only partially: conventional gene selection can overlook spatially structured signals, while methods for encoding cell-cell relationships often either reduce a cell's microenvironment to proximity alone, discarding direction, or rely on absolute coordinates tied to an arbitrary tissue frame. Consequently, cells with similar neighbor distances but distinct spatial organization may receive overly similar representations, despite experiencing different biological contexts that shape their cellular states. We introduce Tessera, a spatial representation learning framework that addresses both molecular selection and cellular context. Tessera combines spatially informed gene selection with a geometric inductive bias that contextualizes each cell within its local tissue environment. By modeling relative cell-cell relationships, Tessera is translation-invariant while preserving direction, allowing neighboring cells to contribute differently according to their spatial context and cellular state. Across held-out tissues and technologies, Tessera outperforms existing spatial foundation models in representation quality and generalizes zero-shot to contexts up to $16\times$ larger than those seen during training.

items.title: gpuGEM: GPU-based linear optimisation of genome-scale metabolic models
items.title_zh: gpuGEM：基于GPU的基因组尺度代谢模型线性优化
items.summary_zh: 摘要：基因组尺度代谢模型在重复优化工作流中日益挑战CPU线性规划求解器。我们提出gpuGEM，一个使用NVIDIA cuOpt进行基于GPU的GEM优化的开源Python库，具有针对HiGHS和Gurobi验证的尺寸自适应设置。在涵盖四个数量级问题规模的十个模型基准套件中，gpuGEM相对于每个模型更快的HiGHS对偶单纯形和内点法实现了1.1倍至94倍的加速。gpuGEM在十个模型中的三个上也优于Gurobi，加速为1.6倍至2.5倍。在候选基因优先级工作流中，gpuGEM将端到端查询时间从41秒减少到21秒。可用性与实现：gpuGEM在MIT许可证下发布于https://github.com/Digital-Metabolic-Twin-Centre/gpuGEM和PyPI（pip install gpugem）。存档版本（v0.1.2）可在https://zenodo.org/rec

extra.description: Summary: Genome-scale metabolic models increasingly challenge CPU linear-programming solvers in repeated-optimisation workflows. We present gpuGEM, an open-source Python library for GPU-based GEM optimisation using NVIDIA cuOpt, with size-adaptive settings validated against HiGHS and Gurobi. Across a ten-model benchmark suite spanning four orders of magnitude in problem size, gpuGEM achieved speed-ups of 1.1x to 94x relative to the faster of the HiGHS dual-simplex and interior-point methods for each model. gpuGEM also outperformed Gurobi on three of ten models, with speed-ups of 1.6x to 2.5x. In a candidate-gene prioritisation workflow, gpuGEM reduced end-to-end query time from 41 s to 21 s. Availability and Implementation: gpuGEM is released under the MIT licence at https://github.com/Digital-Metabolic-Twin-Centre/gpuGEM and on PyPI (pip install gpugem). An archived release(v0.1.2) is available at https://zenodo.org/records/23422813. gpuGEM requires an NVIDIA GPU, Python 3.11 or later, CUDA 12 and cuOpt 26.6 or later. cuOpt requires a GPU with Volta architecture or newer (compute capability 7.0 or newer). Contact: ronan.mt.fleming@gmail.com Supplementary information: Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics online.

items.title: OmicsBench: a long-horizon multi-turn benchmark of AI agents on research-study-scale bioinformatics
items.title_zh: OmicsBench：AI智能体在研究级生物信息学上的长时程多轮基准
items.summary_zh: 计算生物学家越来越多地将大量分析委托给AI智能体进行长时程、多轮会话，但大多数智能体生物信息学能力基准只提出单一短任务和单次提示。我们提出OmicsBench，一个面向AI智能体的长时程、多轮生物信息学基准。其97个任务各自将依赖子任务连接成有向无环图，总共662个底层子任务。每个子任务作为一个用户轮次提出，并针对答案键进行确定性评分，对错误答案提供可选的上下文反馈。在三种框架上的12个模型中，最慢的智能体平均每任务耗时3.6小时，没有任何组合接近饱和该基准，无上下文反馈时平均得分为0.43至0.57（满分1），有反馈时为0.54至0.67。多轮评估还揭示了单次提示无法发现的行为，因为智能体在依赖早期子任务的子任务上得分较低，而上下文反馈帮助智能体挽回部分损失。由于确定性评分无法定性说明智能体如何失败，我们还引入了一个无监督失败模式发现流程，用于描述、嵌入和聚类智能体的失败尝试，以揭示涌现

extra.description: Computational biologists increasingly delegate substantial analyses to AI agents in long-horizon, multi-turn sessions, yet most benchmarks of agents' bioinformatics capabilities pose a single short task with a single-shot prompt. We present OmicsBench, a long-horizon, multi-turn bioinformatics benchmark for AI agents. Each of its 97 tasks links dependent subtasks into a directed acyclic graph, for 662 underlying subtasks in all. Each subtask is posed as one user turn and graded deterministically against an answer key, with optional in-context feedback on incorrect answers. Across 12 models on three harnesses, the slowest agent averages 3.6 hours per task, and no combination comes near saturating the benchmark, with mean scores of 0.43 to 0.57 out of a possible 1 without in-context feedback and 0.54 to 0.67 with it. Multi-turn evaluation also uncovers behavior that single-shot prompts cannot, as agents score lower on subtasks that depend on earlier subtasks, and in-context feedback helps agents recover some of that loss. Because deterministic scoring gives no qualitative account of how an agent failed, we also introduce an unsupervised failure mode discovery pipeline that describes, embeds, and clusters agents' failed attempts to surface emergent failure modes. Applied to OmicsBench, this pipeline exposes qualitative shortcomings in how agents carry out bioinformatics analyses, ranging from agents applying their own statistical filters in place of the specified ones to agents writing whole answers from memory.

items.title: Truecell reproduces R Seurat's single-cell analysis outputs natively in the Python ecosystem
items.title_zh: Truecell 在 Python 生态中原生复现 R Seurat 的单细胞分析输出
items.summary_zh: 单细胞 RNA 测序分析主要使用 Seurat（R）或 Scanpy（Python），选择通常由编程语言偏好驱动。然而，默认情况下，这些工具产生不同的可变特征、邻居图、聚类和标记基因。需要 Python（支持大多数深度学习、基础模型和代理工具）的实验室必须在无法复现 Seurat 结果的框架中重新实现 Seurat 分析。Truecell 被开发为 Seurat 接口的 Python 实现，保留函数名称、参数、默认设置和对象模型，以促进分析的无缝转移。在十八个与 R Seurat 的配对端到端评估中，确定性输出匹配到浮点精度，并且折叠变化顺序在所有九个差异表达测试中相同。在三个数据集上的三臂基准测试中，固定用户参数和每个工具 20 个种子，Truecell 在所有 12 个数据集和分辨率设置组合中比配置 Seurat 的 Scanpy 更接近地复现 Seurat 的聚类。Truecell

extra.description: Single-cell RNA-sequencing analyses predominantly use either Seurat (R) or Scanpy (Python), with the choice often driven by programming language preference. However, by default, these tools produce divergent variable features, neighbour graphs, clusters, and marker genes. Laboratories requiring Python, which supports most deep-learning, foundation-model, and agent tools, must re-implement Seurat analyses in a framework that does not replicate Seurat's results. Truecell was developed as a Python implementation of the Seurat interface, preserving function names, arguments, default settings, and the object model to facilitate seamless transfer of analyses. In eighteen paired end-to-end evaluations against R Seurat, deterministic outputs matched to floating-point precision, and fold-change order was identical across all nine differential expression tests. In a three-arm benchmark on three datasets, with fixed user parameters and 20 seeds per tool, Truecell more closely reproduced Seurat's clustering than a Seurat-configured Scanpy in all 12 combinations of dataset and resolution settings. Truecell's marker genes and enriched pathways were also closer to Seurat's than Scanpy's were, and pseudobulk DESeq2 reproduced Seurat's gene lists with a Jaccard index ranging from 0.95 to 1.00. This agreement reflects fidelity to Seurat rather than biological correctness.

items.title: ProtAgent: Post-Training Compact Protein Tool Agents with Interaction-Level Credit Assignment
items.title_zh: ProtAgent：具有交互级信用分配的训练后紧凑蛋白质工具代理
items.summary_zh: 蛋白质注释代理必须选择合适的生物信息学工具，解释其输出，并在最终答案中使用所得证据。大多数现有系统依赖前沿规模模型。我们询问紧凑模型是否可以通过与真实工具交互的后训练来学习这种行为。我们提出ProtAgent，一个两阶段流水线，使用监督微调（SFT）学习工具接口，并使用标准同策略REINFORCE改进交互策略。中间工具调用获得动作奖励，最终响应获得终端答案奖励。步级回报将这些奖励分配给产生它们的响应以及之前的动作。回合级基线则为每个动作分配一个回合回报。在具有真实生物信息学工具的固定闭环协议上，ProtAgent-8B在注释覆盖率指标下达到61.00%的成功率，而DeepSeek-V3.2-Thinking 671B为41.60%，最强评估前沿系统为60.80%。在三种子比较中，在恒等回报归一化下，回合级回报的平均成功率为42.70%，步级回报为61.40%；相应的组相对结果分别为36.5

extra.description: Protein annotation agents must choose suitable bioinformatics tools, interpret their outputs, and use the resulting evidence in the final answer. Most existing systems rely on frontier-scale models. We ask whether a compact model can instead learn this behavior through post-training with real tool interaction. We present ProtAgent, a two-stage pipeline that uses supervised fine-tuning (SFT) to learn the tool interface and standard on-policy REINFORCE to improve the interaction policy. Intermediate tool calls receive action rewards, and the final response receives a terminal answer reward. Step-level returns assign these rewards to the responses that produced them and to preceding actions. The episode-level baseline instead assigns one episode return to every action. On a fixed closed-loop protocol with real bioinformatics tools, ProtAgent-8B achieves 61.00% success under the annotation-coverage metric, compared with 41.60% for DeepSeek-V3.2-Thinking 671B and 60.80% for the strongest evaluated frontier system. In the three-seed comparison, mean success is 42.70% with episode-level returns and 61.40% with step-level returns under identity return normalization; the corresponding group-relative results are 36.50% and 58.20%. The metric measures recovery of reference annotations under this protocol; it does not by itself establish biological correctness or complete evidence grounding.

items.title: VGL-stGen: Learning a shared multimodal model for lung histology and spatial transcriptomics
items.title_zh: VGL-stGen：学习肺组织学和空间转录组学的共享多模态模型
items.summary_zh: VGL-stGen是一个多模态大语言模型，从预训练医学视觉-语言模型改编而来，使用配对的肺H&E和空间转录组学及单细胞参考。训练整合了图像-表达和表达-细胞类型配对，基因条件伪标签将转录组细胞类型监督转移到组织学图像。一个部署的检查点支持十三项评估任务，涵盖组织和细胞类型分类、基因预测以及从组织学、细胞身份和观察到的基因表达组合进行条件表达完成。任务特定解码产生分类标签、基因列表和结构化表达水平。对于条件完成，固定查询基因身份并自回归预测其水平可改善结构化预测。受控适应表明，将监督限制在请求的表达水平标记上可以进一步改善图像条件完成。图像置换实验表明，正确配对的组织学增加了超出观察表达的信息。外部分类部分依赖具有共享注释谱系的计算参考，一些H&E来源在癌症训练或模型开发期间被暴露。在这些条件下，VGL-stGen展示了医学视觉-语言骨干如何从空间转录组学和组织学中学习，通过共享生成建模连接

extra.description: VGL-stGen is a multimodal large language model adapted from a pretrained medical vision-language model using paired lung H&E and spatial transcriptomics with single-cell references. Training integrates image-expression and expression-cell-type pairs, and gene-conditioned pseudo-labels transfer transcriptomic cell-type supervision to histology images. One deployed checkpoint supports thirteen evaluated tasks spanning tissue and cell-type classification, gene prediction and conditional expression completion from combinations of histology, cell identity and observed gene expression. Task-specific decoding produces categorical labels, gene lists and structured expression levels. For conditional completion, fixing queried gene identities and predicting their levels autoregressively improves structured prediction. Controlled adaptation shows that restricting supervision to requested expression-level tokens can further improve image-conditioned completion. Image-permutation experiments indicate that correctly paired histology adds information beyond observed expression. External classification relies partly on computational references with shared annotation lineage, and some H&E sources were exposed during cancer training or model development. Within these conditions, VGL-stGen demonstrates how a medical vision-language backbone can learn from spatial transcriptomics and histology to connect tissue morphology and molecular states through shared generative modeling.

items.title: BARRR: Bidimensional Augmented Reduced Rank Regression for Multi-View Multi-Cohort Data
items.title_zh: BARRR：用于多视图多队列数据的双向增强降秩回归
items.summary_zh: 跨多个队列（即样本组）和视图（即来源或模态）的双向数据整合在生物医学研究中至关重要，以从异质数据集中获得整体见解。然而，大多数现有整合方法侧重于单一维度，如跨不同来源的多视图整合或跨不同样本组的多队列整合。现有的双向整合方法稀缺且主要无监督，忽视了协变量提供的宝贵见解。为解决这一空白，我们引入双向增强降秩回归（baRRR）方法。我们的方法同时建模协变量相关和不相关效应，同时在两个维度上分解效应水平（全局、部分共享和个体）。大量模拟证明了我们的方法在信号恢复、结果预测和缺失数据插补方面的优势。我们将方法应用于癌症基因组图谱（TCGA）数据，使用体细胞突变作为协变量来告知不同组学平台和癌症类型间的变异模式。这些研究突出了其作为生物医学研究中稳健且适应性强的整合分析工具的潜力。

extra.description: Bidimensional data integration across multiple cohorts (i.e., sample groups) and views (i.e., sources or modalities) is crucial in biomedical research to derive holistic insights from heterogeneous datasets. However, most existing integrative methods focus on a single dimension, such as multi-view integration across distinct sources or multi-cohort integration across distinct sample groups. Existing approaches for bidimensional integration are scarce and predominantly unsupervised, overlooking the valuable insights offered by covariates. To address this gap, we introduce the Bidimensional Augmented Reduced Rank Regression (baRRR) method. Our approach models covariate-related and unrelated effects concurrently, while also decomposing effect levels (global, partially shared, and individual) across both dimensions. Extensive simulations demonstrate the advantages of our method with respect to signal recovery, outcome prediction, and missing data imputation. We apply our approach to data from The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA), using somatic mutations as covariates to inform patterns of variability across different omics platforms and cancer types. These studies highlight its potential as a robust and adaptable tool for integrative analysis in biomedical research.

items.title: Reducing double-dipping in single-cell topic models with three-way count splitting
items.title_zh: 用三向计数拆分减少单细胞主题模型中的双重 dipping
items.summary_zh: 主题模型从单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）数据中学习基因程序，然后相同的计数被用于测试哪些基因和供体与这些程序相关。计数拆分是这种复用的标准补救措施，但当编码器读取每个细胞的计数时尚未被测试。在一个104,400细胞的狼疮队列中，每次运行300个置换零基因，朴素检验在名义5%水平下拒绝了36%的零基因-主题对，而通常的两向拆分拒绝了38%，因为编码器看到了被检验基因自身的留出计数。在单独的第三个计数上编码主题使用，使用beta-二项稀疏化，将此降低到7.7%（模型外基因为6.7%）；对于另外两个模型LDVAE和scETM，该率为7.0-7.3%（朴素为51-59%）。一个无标签干扰素程序在狼疮队列和预先指定的COVID-19队列的留出计数中发生偏移，供体水平主题使用预测疾病（AUROC 0.96），超越细胞类型比例（两个队列中分别为0.86和0.58）。校准和预测不依赖于模型。我们不

extra.description: Topic models learn gene programs from single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) data, and the same counts are then used to test which genes and donors are associated with those programs. Count splitting is the standard remedy for this reuse, but it has not been tested when an encoder reads each cell's counts. On a 104,400-cell lupus cohort with 300 permuted null genes per run, naive tests rejected 36% of null gene-topic pairs at a nominal 5% level, and the usual two-way split rejected 38%, because the encoder sees the tested gene's own held-out count. Encoding topic usage on a separate third of the counts, with beta-binomial thinning, lowered this to 7.7% (6.7% for genes outside the model); for two other models, LDVAE and scETM, the rate was 7.0-7.3% (naive 51-59%). A label-free interferon program shifts in held-out counts in the lupus cohort and in a pre-specified COVID-19 cohort, and donor-level topic usage predicts disease (AUROC 0.96) beyond cell-type proportions (0.86 and 0.58 in the two cohorts). Calibration and prediction did not depend on the model. We do not claim better clustering, prediction or topic stability. Code, figures and result tables are public (MIT license; DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23307193).

items.title: Understanding Gene Expression-to-Image Learning: Spatial Structure and Information Fidelity
items.title_zh: 理解基因表达到图像学习：空间结构与信息保真度
items.summary_zh: 单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）使生物异质性的细胞水平分析成为可能，但从高维、无序基因表达谱学习有效表示仍具挑战性。基因表达到图像（GE2I）通过将基因值排列在像素网格上供卷积神经网络使用，提供了一种有效学习策略，但其潜在机制仍不清楚。我们在全转录组数据上研究GE2I，同时保持网络和训练过程固定。我们的结果揭示了空间平滑性与基因级保真度之间的权衡。结构化映射产生平滑的低频模式，支持更快的早期优化，而将多个基因分配到同一像素会模糊表达差异并可能降低预测性能。这种权衡解释了为什么当表示许多基因时，随机映射可以与结构化布局竞争。即使图像平滑性降低，一对一基因到像素分配在测试的视觉骨干网络中也能改善预测。我们进一步发现预训练和增强的益处取决于骨干网络和映射。这些发现为像素分配和将视觉先验迁移到基因表达数据提供了实用指导。

extra.description: Single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) enables cell-level analysis of biological heterogeneity, but learning effective representations from high-dimensional, unordered gene expression profiles remains challenging. Gene Expression-to-Image (GE2I) offers an effective learning strategy by arranging gene values on pixel grids for convolutional neural networks, but its underlying mechanisms remain unclear. We study GE2I on full-transcriptome data while keeping the network and training procedure fixed. Our results reveal a trade-off between spatial smoothness and gene-level fidelity. Structured mappings produce smooth, low-frequency patterns that support faster early optimization, whereas assigning multiple genes to the same pixel obscures expression differences and can reduce predictive performance. This trade-off explains why random mappings can compete with structured layouts when many genes are represented. One-to-one gene-to-pixel assignment improves prediction across the tested visual backbones even when image smoothness decreases. We further find that the benefits of pretraining and augmentation depend on the backbone and mapping. These findings provide practical guidance for pixel allocation and the transfer of vision priors to gene expression data.

items.title: Predictive Multiplicity in Cell-Fate Assignment: Label-Free Rashomon Sets and the Limits of Per-Cell Certification
items.title_zh: 细胞命运分配中的预测多重性：无标签 Rashomon 集和逐细胞认证的局限
items.summary_zh: 单细胞轨迹推断将转录组测量映射到发育连续体上，但同样拟合数据的配置可能分配冲突的细胞命运。FateMultiplicity 是一个无标签框架，通过评估交叉拟合留出基因上的模型差异，在非劣效性测试下针对随机种子变异进行校准，构建统计可接受的模型集或 Rashomon 集，无需谱系标签。多重性很大，更多取决于模型空间的多样性而非其大小：第二个算法的十二种配置暴露 20.0% 的细胞，而第一个算法的二十四种配置暴露 3.8%。然后测试逐细胞认证命运边际 FM 是否比拟合模型已提供的产生更可靠的分配，结果并非如此。在模拟真实值上，在相同细胞上，FM 以 AUC 0.682 区分错误分配，而基线配置自身的决策边际为 0.965（p = 0.003），种子离散基线为 0.854。信息量由所接纳集的广度而非其基数决定：在基数四时，种子重拟合给出 0.933，超参数扰动集给出 0.701。将下确界放宽到

extra.description: Single-cell trajectory inference maps transcriptomic measurements onto developmental continua, yet configurations that fit the data equally well can assign conflicting cell fates. FateMultiplicity is a label-free framework that constructs a statistically admissible model set, or Rashomon set, without lineage labels, by evaluating model discrepancy on cross-fitted held-out genes under non-inferiority testing calibrated against random-seed variation. Multiplicity is large and depends more on the diversity of the model space than its size: twelve configurations of a second algorithm expose 20.0% of cells where twenty-four of the first expose 3.8%. Whether the per-cell certified fate margin FM yields more reliable assignments than the fitted model already provides is then tested, and it does not. On simulation ground truth, on the same cells, FM discriminates misassignment at AUC 0.682, against 0.965 for the baseline configuration's own decision margin (p = 0.003) and 0.854 for a seed-dispersion baseline. Informativeness is governed by the breadth of the admitted set, not its cardinality: at cardinality four, seed refits give 0.933 and hyperparameter-perturbed sets 0.701. Relaxing the infimum to a q-quantile recovers discrimination but converges toward the single model's own confidence; the supremum reaches 0.973 because theta*'s membership bounds it from below, while the infimum is unanchored. Multiplicity in trajectory inference is worth measuring and reporting, but per-cell certification over a label-free Rashomon set is not a route to more reliable fate calls. Two constructions survive: a margin-erosion ratio separates real from spurious branch points in simulation (AUC 0.890, untested on real data), and against clonally observed fate, uncertified cells disagree with their clone's outcome 16.4 percentage points more often than certified cells (p < 0.001).

items.title: RADAgent: Automating RADseq Pipelines with Private Open-Source LLMs
items.title_zh: RADAgent：用私有开源LLM自动化RADseq流水线
items.summary_zh: 限制性位点相关DNA测序（RADseq）是一类简化代表性测序方法。它使用限制性内切酶对基因组子集进行采样，从而允许以低成本对多个个体一起进行测序和基因分型。RADseq广泛用于种群基因组学、进化生物学、标记发现和SNP面板开发，但完整分析仍需要专家协调多个工具和处理阶段。传统的RADseq分析需要专家协调异构生物信息学工具、中间工件、质量控制检查以及跨多个阶段的参数依赖决策。虽然单个步骤可以脚本化，但执行完整工作流仍需要人工监督以进行状态跟踪、结果验证和故障处理。为了自动化这种专家驱动的协调，我们提出RADAgent，它引入了一种模块化代理方法，使用开放权重LLM可靠执行RADseq工作流。RADAgent将RADseq工作流的自然边界映射为16个独立可执行和可验证的代理模块，并使用模型无关的运行时进行有界工具执行、磁盘验证和故障恢复。我们在包含来自19个种群的476个样本的真实种群基因组

extra.description: Restriction site-associated DNA sequencing (RADseq) is a family of reduced-representation sequencing methods. It uses restriction enzymes to sample subsets of the genome, therefore allowing multiple individuals to be sequenced and genotyped together at low cost. RADseq is widely used for population genomics, evolutionary biology, marker discovery, and the development of SNP panels, but complete analysis still requires expert coordination across multiple tools and processing stages. Traditional RADseq analysis requires expert coordination of heterogeneous bioinformatics tools, intermediate artifacts, quality-control checks, and parameter-dependent decisions across multiple stages. Although individual steps can be scripted, executing the complete workflow still requires human oversight for state tracking, result validation, and failure handling. To automate this expert-driven coordination, we present RADAgent, which introduces a modular agentic method for reliable RADseq workflow execution with an open-weight LLM. RADAgent maps the natural boundaries of the RADseq workflow into 16 independently executable and verifiable agent modules and uses a model-independent runtime for bounded tool execution, on-disk verification, and failure recovery. We evaluate RADAgent on a real population-genomics dataset containing 476 samples from 19 populations. The results demonstrate that RADAgent reliably automates the complete RADseq workflow with an open-weight LLM while keeping genomic data and model execution within the local computing environment. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/wenlu-lab/RADAgent.

items.title: An Exploratory Multiome Analysis of a BCG-Associated HSPC Signature: Trained-Immunity Marker in Blood and an Adverse Prognostic Association in Tumour
items.title_zh: BCG相关HSPC特征的探索性多组学分析：血液中的训练免疫标志物与肿瘤中的不良预后关联
items.summary_zh: 膀胱内卡介苗（BCG）是非肌层浸润性膀胱癌（NMIBC）的既定治疗方法，近期证据表明膀胱BCG诱导造血干细胞和祖细胞（HSPC）的转录和染色质变化。然而，这些BCG相关变化的联合多组学结构及其定义可转移分子特征的潜力仍未充分表征。本研究对两名NMIBC患者在BCG治疗前后采样的配对单细胞RNA-seq和ATAC-seq数据进行了探索性整合分析。经过预处理和条形码级整合，使用多组学因子分析（MOFA+）对653个HSPC进行分析，使用2,000个HSPC特异性可变基因和25,000个可变染色质可及性峰。在十个潜在因子中，因子1与BCG状态的关联最强（$r=0.495$），并捕捉了两个分子视图的变异。因子1的RNA权重用于推导候选基因特征，这些特征在患者特异性模型之间显示出部分一致性。跨背景评估显示与TCGA-BLCA中的总生存期和GSE199471中的复发相关，而特征基因的一个子集在GSE1

extra.description: Intravesical Bacillus Calmette--Guérin (BCG) is an established treatment for non-muscle-invasive bladder cancer (NMIBC), and recent evidence indicates that bladder BCG induces transcriptional and chromatin changes in hematopoietic stem and progenitor cells (HSPCs). However, the joint multi-omic structure of these BCG-associated changes and its potential to define transferable molecular signatures remain less well characterized. This study performed an exploratory integrative analysis of paired single-cell RNA-seq and ATAC-seq data from two NMIBC patients sampled before and after BCG treatment. Following preprocessing and barcode-level integration, 653 HSPCs were analysed using Multi-Omics Factor Analysis (MOFA+) with 2,000 HSPC-specific variable genes and 25,000 variable chromatin-accessibility peaks. Of ten latent factors, Factor~1 showed the strongest association with BCG status ($r=0.495$) and captured variation across both molecular views. RNA weights from Factor~1 were used to derive candidate gene signatures that showed partial consistency across patient-specific models. Cross-context evaluation showed associations with overall survival in TCGA-BLCA and recurrence in GSE199471, while a subset of signature genes showed consistent directional changes in monocytes following BCG vaccination in GSE184241. Together, these findings identify a candidate multi-omic axis associated with BCG exposure and suggest that its derived molecular signatures exhibit context-dependent behaviour across distinct biological and clinical settings.

items.title: Protocol for Discovering Convergent Molecular Networks across Multi-Omics Datasets Using Network Propagation
items.title_zh: 使用网络传播跨多组学数据集发现趋同分子网络的方案
items.summary_zh: 表型结果源于分子层之间的协调变化。尽管多组学数据捕捉互补的分子信号，但由于基因水平重叠有限，将其整合为连贯的生物机制仍然具有挑战性。网络传播将每个数据集中的重要基因命中映射到先验知识分子相互作用网络上，并将其信号扩散到邻近基因。对传播网络进行数学整合，随后进行聚类和通路富集，可揭示共享分子网络，从而指出跨正交分子层捕捉到的核心生物学。

extra.description: Phenotypic outcomes arise from coordinated changes across molecular layers. Although multi-omics data capture complementary molecular signals, integrating them into coherent biological mechanisms remains challenging due to limited overlap at the gene level. Network propagation maps significant gene hits from each dataset onto a prior knowledge molecular interaction network and diffuses their signals to neighboring genes. Mathematical integration of propagated networks, followed by clustering and pathway enrichment, reveals shared molecular networks, pinpointing the core biology captured across orthogonal molecular layers.

items.title: TCSP3.0: Template-Based Crystal Structure Prediction with Coefficient-Preserving Element Substitution and Structural Diversity
items.title_zh: TCSP3.0：基于模板的晶体结构预测，具有保系数元素替换和结构多样性
items.summary_zh: 基于模板的晶体结构预测（CSP）通过元素替换将已知晶体结构转移到新组成，因此其准确性取决于检索合适的模板、映射元素并正确排序所得候选。在T180基准上审计原始TCSP2.0实现时，我们发现其2,347个选定结构中有469个（20%）组成错误，原因是元素映射忽略了化学计量系数，以及顺序文本替换级联或损坏元素符号。我们提出TCSP3.0，它强制保系数映射，在解析结构上同时替换物种，并验证每个候选的组成和晶胞。它进一步增加了周期数检索、软氧化态证据、半径兼容性评分、结构去重，以及ORB-v3机器学习势弛豫和候选能量排序，如深度生成CSP基线所用。TCSP3.0在T180上达到72.2%和90.6%的Top-1和Top-20匹配率，而TCSP2.0为28.3%和45.6%，并在新的800目标基准（T800）上达到74.0%的Top-20匹配率。在T180上它还优于PNcsp+和深度生成模型Crys

extra.description: Template-based crystal structure prediction (CSP) transfers a known crystal structure to a new composition by element substitution, so its accuracy depends on retrieving suitable templates, mapping elements and ranking the resulting candidates correctly. Auditing the original TCSP2.0 implementation on the T180 benchmark, we found that 469 of its 2,347 selected structures (20%) have the wrong composition, caused by element mappings that ignore stoichiometric coefficients and by sequential text substitution that cascades or corrupts element symbols. We propose TCSP3.0, which enforces coefficient-preserving mappings, substitutes species simultaneously on parsed structures and validates every candidate's composition and cell. It further adds periodic-number retrieval, soft oxidation-state evidence, radius-compatibility scoring, structural deduplication, and ORB-v3 machine-learning-potential relaxation and energy ranking of its candidates, as used by deep generative CSP baselines. TCSP3.0 achieves Top-1 and Top-20 match rates of 72.2% and 90.6% on T180, compared with 28.3% and 45.6% for TCSP2.0, and a Top-20 match rate of 74.0% on a new 800-target benchmark (T800). On T180 it also outperforms PNcsp+ and deep generative models CrystalFlow and MaskGXT (Top-1 72.2% versus at most 63.9%). Even without relaxation, TCSP3.0 reaches 67.8% at Top-1 and 90.6% at Top-20 in a median of 28 s per target on two CPU cores, about ten times faster than CrystalFlow. Paired ten-arm ablations on T180 and T800 show that most of the improvement comes from the correctness fixes; structural deduplication significantly improves the Top-5 match rate, embedding-based retrieval is required for coverage, and the remaining scoring features have small or null effects.

items.title: The Information Geometry of Representation Formation
items.title_zh: 表示形成的信息几何
items.summary_zh: 大多数神经表示分析集中在训练终点，而内部结构形成的过程相对未被测量。我们转而将表示形成本身作为研究对象，询问表示在训练中所走的路径是否揭示了其终点所没有的信息。我们通过将表示学习视为几何轨迹来形式化这一想法，使用Bures几何测量在表示空间中的移动，使用量子Fisher信息表征对输入因素的局部敏感性。我们发现学习将局部敏感性集中在任务相关因素上，并且仅改变预测目标就会围绕相应的视觉因素重组这种几何。更引人注目的是，随着学习的计算需要输入因素之间的高阶交互，表示轨迹系统性地变得不那么直接。这种效应在匹配性能和训练时长控制下持续存在，并从合成向量输入转移到渲染和自然图像上的残差CNN。重要的是，形成历史包含关于学习表示稳定性的预测信息：控制交互阶数后，路径曲折度预测其在持续训练下的后续漂移和对参数扰动的敏感性，而终点位移则不能。最后，表示感知优化让我们能够主动塑造这些轨迹，表明形成几何不仅可测

extra.description: Most analyses of neural representations focus on trained endpoints, leaving the process by which internal structure forms comparatively unmeasured. We instead treat representation formation itself as an object of study, asking whether the path a representation takes through training reveals information that its endpoint does not. We formalize this idea by viewing representation learning as a geometric trajectory, using Bures geometry to measure movement through representation space and quantum Fisher information to characterize local sensitivity to input factors. We find that learning concentrates local sensitivity on task-relevant factors, and that changing only the prediction target reorganizes this geometry around the corresponding visual factor. More strikingly, representation trajectories become systematically less direct as the learned computation requires higher-order interactions among input factors. This effect persists under matched-performance and training-duration controls and transfers from synthetic vector inputs to residual CNNs on rendered and natural images. Importantly, formation history contains predictive information about the stability of the learned representation: controlling for interaction order, path tortuosity predicts its subsequent drift under continued training and sensitivity to parameter perturbations, whereas endpoint displacement does not. Finally, representation-aware optimization lets us actively shape these trajectories, showing that formation geometry is not only measurable but actionable. Together, these results establish representation formation as a new source of information about learning: its geometry reveals properties of the computation being constructed, predicts subsequent representational stability, and provides a target for intervention during optimization.

items.title: EmoNet: A Lightweight Attention-Based CNN for Speech Emotion Recognition
items.title_zh: EmoNet：用于语音情感识别的轻量级注意力CNN
items.summary_zh: 语音情感识别（SER）是情感计算中的一项基础任务，支持心理健康评估、人机交互和自动客户支持系统等应用。由于说话者风格、声学条件的变化以及现代深度学习方法的高计算成本，从语音中准确分类情感仍然具有挑战性。许多现有系统依赖大型基于Transformer的架构，需要大量计算资源，使其不太适合实时或资源受限环境。本研究提出EmoNet，一个轻量级深度学习框架，用于跨七种情感类别的语音情感分类。该模型建立在具有挤压-激励注意力和残差连接的四块深度可分离CNN编码器之上，结合用于时间特征学习的双向LSTM和用于改进表示的多头注意力池化机制。采用全面的134通道声学特征集以及包括音频级扰动和SpecAugment在内的数据增强技术，以提高在不同声学条件下的鲁棒性。在TESS、RAVDESS和SAVEE的组合数据集上评估，EmoNet仅用411万参数就达到96.75%的测试准确率。所提出的模型优于其复现基

extra.description: Speech Emotion Recognition (SER) is a fundamental task in affective computing that enables applications such as mental health assessment, human-computer interaction, and automated customer support systems. Accurate emotion classification from speech remains challenging due to variations in speaker style, acoustic conditions, and the high computational cost of modern deep learning approaches. Many existing systems depend on large transformer-based architectures that require substantial computational resources, making them less suitable for real-time or resource-constrained environments. This research proposes EmoNet, a lightweight deep learning framework for speech emotion classification across seven emotion categories. The model is built on a four-block depthwise separable CNN encoder with squeeze-and-excitation attention and residual connections, combined with a Bidirectional LSTM for temporal feature learning and a multi-head attention pooling mechanism for improved representation. A comprehensive 134-channel acoustic feature set alongside data augmentation techniques including audio-level perturbations and SpecAugment is employed to improve robustness under diverse acoustic conditions. Evaluated on a combined dataset of TESS, RAVDESS, and SAVEE, EmoNet achieves a test accuracy of 96.75% with only 4.11 million parameters. The proposed model outperforms its reproduced baseline and remains competitive with significantly larger state-of-the-art architectures.

items.title: Signal Associa: hot tumors elicit field-spanning NK cell coordination linked to their recruitment
items.title_zh: Signal Associa：热肿瘤引发与招募相关的跨场NK细胞协调
items.summary_zh: 细胞通过耦合动力学进行协调，但观察到的相关性是否反映真正的耦合很少被检验。Signal Associa是一个开源框架，将六种耦合方法与自动平稳化和替代测试相结合。针对六个真值系统进行基准测试，揭示了耦合机制的三分法，每种都有不同的最佳方法：相关性用于由共享趋势和周期承载的耦合，Granger因果用于线性随机耦合，收敛交叉映射用于非线性耦合；方法间的一致性从数据中识别机制。在三个结直肠肿瘤微环境中的13部自然杀伤（NK）细胞电影中，NK细胞以保守速率形成跨场耦合网络；在匹配的肿瘤信号暴露下，热肿瘤周围的NK细胞更全局整合，而具有更整合NK网络的热肿瘤倾向于吸引更多NK细胞。在黏着斑中，刚度增强了vinculin-FAK耦合，在突出边缘最为明显。替代测试将滞后相关假阳性从23-92%降至约5%。

extra.description: Cells coordinate through coupled dynamics, yet whether observed correlations reflect genuine coupling is rarely tested. Signal Associa is an open-source framework uniting six coupling methods with automated stationarization and surrogate testing. Benchmarking against six ground truth systems reveals a trichotomy of coupling regimes, each with a different best method: correlation for coupling carried by shared trends and cycles, Granger causality for linear stochastic coupling, and convergent cross-mapping for nonlinear coupling; agreement across methods identifies the regime from data. In 13 movies of natural killer (NK) cells across three colorectal tumor microenvironments, NK cells formed field-spanning coupling networks at a conserved rate; at matched exposure to tumor signal, NK cells around hot tumors were more globally integrated, and hot tumors with a more integrated NK network tended to attract more NK cells. In focal adhesions, stiffness strengthened vinculin-FAK coupling, most at protruding edges. Surrogates cut lagged-correlation false positives from 23-92% to about 5%.

items.title: 内存市场出现局部价格倒挂，渠道商面临库存压力选择降价清库存，普通消费者现在适合入手吗？
items.title_zh: 内存市场出现局部价格倒挂，渠道商面临库存压力选择降价清库存，普通消费者现在适合入手吗？
items.summary_zh: 10月26日，据央视网，调查发现，目前内存销量比价格波动更加明显，走访中多位商家反映，10月份以来他们的销量普遍下滑20%至30%，整个内存流通渠道甚至出现了价格倒挂的情况。目前内存出厂价仍然在涨，但是由于不少渠道商前期囤了很多货，而大部分消费者在内存价格高企的时刻选择观望，整个市场需求下滑，为了迅速回笼资金减轻库存压力，不少渠道商还是会选择降价出货。业内人士告诉记者，内存市场价格出现小幅下调，主要是有些渠道商资金压力大，必须出货回笼资金，但大家都是高成本进货，谁也不敢降太多，于是市场出现了报价坚挺、成交冷清、局部倒挂的现象，整个渠道库存和资金压力正在累积。内存条有价无市：出厂价还在涨 渠道价已经倒挂_腾讯新闻

items.title_zh: 如何看待老干妈回应「用AI把600名工人裁到48人」，称是不实信息？品牌能挽回消费者信任吗？
items.summary_zh: 据蓝鲸新闻报道，10月26日，“老干妈AI裁员传闻引争议”话题再度登社交平台热搜，蓝鲸新闻记者向老干妈官方热线求证，接线工作人员回应称，相关AI裁员传闻为不实信息，公司从未发布此类信息，请消费者理性看待。 近日，据界面新闻，老干妈常务副总、首席质量官李鑫在2026年贵州省质量发展大会上对外透露，“通过四年的质量巩固与体系优化，2025年，我们营收达54亿元，创历史最高峰值。” 随后，在网络上不少自媒体发文，称“老干妈用AI把600名工人裁到48人，自己年营收高达54亿”，相关内容引发热议，甚至有消费者表示不再购买老干妈。 受此传闻影响，老干妈近日线上销售额出现明显下跌，以某电商平台为例，第三方数据平台显示，10月22日起老干妈连续多日销售额为1000—5000元，而在传闻开始前，其日销售额多稳定在5000—1万元。https://baijiahao.baidu.com/s?id=18801

items.title: 「南北」奥迪正式分家，四环归一汽，AUDI 归上汽，背后出于怎样的商业考量？将带来哪些影响？
items.title_zh: 「南北」奥迪正式分家，四环归一汽，AUDI 归上汽，背后出于怎样的商业考量？将带来哪些影响？
items.summary_zh: 持续近十年的“南北”奥迪纷争，终于有了明确的解决方案。 10月26日，奥迪中国宣布，字母标AUDI由上汽奥迪负责，四环品牌归一汽奥迪。声明称，中国一汽将强化奥迪四环品牌在智能豪华新能源车型和燃油车型双领域的市场优势，以全面智能化的豪华产品矩阵，持续发挥这一深耕中国市场、以设计与科技驱动的豪华品牌的市场优势；上汽奥迪将聚焦AUDI（奥迪字母标）品牌、专注新能源市场，推出符合中国消费者需求的下一代智能网联汽车。 奥迪中国表示，此次战略调整不会影响用户权益，在售车型售后服务、经销渠道均保持稳定，上汽奥迪在2027年底前仍可正常销售四环车型。 就在四天前，奥迪中国还宣布了一项重要人事变动。自11月1日起，张俊将接替罗英瀚（Johannes Roscheck）出任奥迪中国总裁。这是奥迪中国成立以来，首次由华人高管担任最高负责人。与此同时，奥迪运动有限公司现任总经理Rolf Michl将赴中国担任首席

items.title: 苹果称很多客户取消 iPhone Duo 订单，具体是什么原因？其他购买渠道靠谱吗？
items.title_zh: 苹果称很多客户取消 iPhone Duo 订单，具体是什么原因？其他购买渠道靠谱吗？
items.summary_zh: 【#苹果回应iPhoneDuo破发##苹果称很多客户取消iPhoneDuo订单#】据新黄河报道，10月25日，苹果首款折叠屏手机iPhone Duo正式发售仅两天，部分渠道的价格已经跌破官方定价。虽然苹果官网部分订单的预计交付时间仍排到2027年1月，但线下经销商已出现低于原价的现货报价。还有消费者通过地方补贴，以15499元买到了原价15999元的256GB版本。针对“部分渠道iPhoneDuo破发”的情况，26日，苹果官方客服人员对@中新经纬 回应称：“第三方经销商退换货政策不一定和苹果官网一致，苹果官方渠道是支持14天无理由退换货。第三方渠道可能有平台补贴或者店铺优惠，苹果官网价格更稳定。”“有的第三方货源足但是买的人少也可能导致降价。”客服称。上述客服还补充道，“有的客户订单显示等待时间比较长，但后续收货时间可能会提前，比如增加产能或者前面排队的客户取消订单，目前很多客户取消了订单

items.title: 物业设电子屏滚动播放业主欠缴费用，包含姓氏、楼栋等信息，这一行为合法吗？有没有更好的催收办法？
items.title_zh: 物业设电子屏滚动播放业主欠缴费用，包含姓氏、楼栋等信息，这一行为合法吗？有没有更好的催收办法？
items.summary_zh: 近日，网络流传的一则“物业将欠费业主姓氏、楼栋以及金额在电子屏轮播”的视频引发舆论广泛关注。该视频显示，电子屏被设置在小区进门闸机处，电子屏显示有欠费业主的姓氏、楼栋以及具体金额，业主的名字用“*”打码。 10月24日，红星新闻记者多方核实到，视频所拍摄的小区位于宁波市北仑区，该小区物业相关人员以及该小区所属社区工作人员均表示，电子屏确为小区物业所设。 物业称物业费欠款金额达数百万 公司预计10月底撤场 该小区物业相关负责人称，电子屏系今年6月份挂出，该小区欠费业主较多，电子屏未公布具体房号，也没有公布业主全名以及联系方式，只显示了楼栋号以及欠费金额，其认为这并不算泄露隐私。 该负责人表示，今年年初清理过往欠款时发现，物业费欠款总金额达到了数百万元，相当于该物业公司一年的饱和收入，“哪个物业公司能垫得起这部分费用？” 该负责人称，因为无力负担费用，该物业公司预计在今年10月底从该小区撤场，

items.title: 小鹏X9撞烂报废安全气囊未弹出，官方称未达气囊碰撞传感器触发条件，怎样看待这一回应？触发条件是什么？
items.title_zh: 小鹏X9撞烂报废安全气囊未弹出，官方称未达气囊碰撞传感器触发条件，怎样看待这一回应？触发条件是什么？
items.summary_zh: 小鹏MPV车型因发生事故后安全气囊未弹出引发关注。 据南京晨报，10月15日，刘先生驾驶小鹏X9过程中撞上了路牙，然后车辆失控接连撞上行道树和电线杆，随后车辆发生侧翻，车头被撞稀巴烂，所幸没有发生人员伤亡。保险公司勘察后认为，这辆车毁损严重，已经没有维修的必要，建议直接报废。 “幸亏事故发生时只是车辆毁损，我们人员没有受伤，安全气囊在这种情况下都没有弹出，这也太没有安全感了。”刘先生说，他的这辆小鹏X9刚刚买了两年，当时花了接近50万买的，结果发生严重事故安全气囊都没有打开。 小鹏汽车在发给记者的邮件中回应表示：“该客户车辆10月15日发生碰撞。经后台数据和行车视频分析，碰撞发生时车辆处于手动驾驶状态，碰撞前驾驶员持续踩加速踏板并猛打方向盘。本次事故未达到车辆安全气囊碰撞传感器触发条件，针对客户提出委托第三方鉴定的诉求，我司尊重客户诉求，会配合做好后续工作。”车辆被撞“报废”安全气囊未弹出

items.title: 蒋诗萌与贾玲的体型相近，都是以自黑出圈，贾玲转行当导演后，你认为她能顶替贾玲的生态位吗？
items.title_zh: 蒋诗萌与贾玲的体型相近，都是以自黑出圈，贾玲转行当导演后，你认为她能顶替贾玲的生态位吗？
items.summary_zh: 自从贾玲转行当导演，马丽独撑半边天。“松弛有魅力的女喜剧演员”赛道，亟需有人补位。 最近打开视频网站，大概率会撞见同一张喜剧脸。观众一边觉得贼眼熟，一边得使劲挠头想她的名字。 《余红旧事》里装神弄鬼的万仙儿，《蒸蒸日上》里的财务小姐姐，《喜剧之王》里的经纪人，还有综艺《大哥小助理》里的蒋诗萌本人…从悬疑剧、律政剧到纯喜剧，她无缝衔接地“霸屏”。再往前倒，她让人印象深刻的角色还有《装腔启示录》里走丧葬风得罪大客户的律师“大王”。 提到蒋诗萌，绕不开一个标签：贾玲的同门师妹。作为女喜剧演员，她们确有相似之处。蒋诗萌和贾玲都是胖女孩，身上有一种天然的亲和力。但她们的成名路径截然相反。 贾玲凭借“自黑”的勇气，塑造女汉子形象，以模仿表演和天生的幽默感，赢得观众喜爱。蒋诗萌最初也是靠“胖”得到机会，但她已经不能复刻贾玲的成名路了。 因为有些观众认为，以自嘲长相、身材作为喜剧素材也是一种对女性的冒犯，

items.title: 付巧妹团队 Nature 论文发现「许家窑人是丹尼索瓦人」，如何理解这一研究的意义？
items.title_zh: 付巧妹团队 Nature 论文发现「许家窑人是丹尼索瓦人」，如何理解这一研究的意义？
items.summary_zh: Nature | 付巧妹团队研究发现许家窑人是丹尼索瓦人 东亚晚中更新世人属的分类与演化关系长期存在争议，许家窑遗址因化石材料丰富、地层年代明确而成为讨论的关键地点。近日，中国科学院古脊椎动物与古人类研究所付巧妹团队完成了题为《The proteome of Middle Pleistocene Xujiayao and common Denisovan morphology》的研究，团队对许家窑两件人骨标本开展了古蛋白提取和质谱分析。研究团队还把蛋白数据与东亚晚中更新世古老人属化石的形态资料结合起来比较，讨论许家窑化石的系统位置和丹尼索瓦人的共同形态。https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-026-11132-z 许家窑两件标本分别取自右侧顶骨和下颌支，研究团队从酸溶和酸不溶组分中获得了18个内源性古蛋白，其中PA1490有13个、PA1497有15
